summary: Power board with 3.3 V input, 1.8 V output via fixed LDO, and power indicator LED on 1.8 V rail.
purpose: Provide regulated 1.8 V power from a 3.3 V source, with a yellow power indicator LED on the 1.8 V rail.
constraints: Yellow power-indicator LED on the 1.8 V rail
Current-limiting resistor for the LED (target current ~1 mA)

required.detail: 2-pin connector (one for 3.3 V input, one for 1.8 V output)
Current-limiting resistor for the LED (target current ~1 mA)
